routing_warnings.description: This message verifies the manual fallback for importing contacts without email addresses rather than automated Apollo-to-HubSpot synchronization.
This message concerns creating a MeetAlfred campaign from HubSpot, not transferring Apollo contacts into HubSpot.
This failure concerns HubSpot leads reaching MeetAlfred, downstream of the target Requirement.
This message verifies the LinkedIn-to-Apollo portion of the pipeline.
This message reports the behavior of the HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred Zap, not the Apollo-to-HubSpot integration.
This message defines the accepted Apollo-mediated lead path rather than direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot synchronization.
The observed transfer is explicitly from LinkedIn to Apollo, not directly from LinkedIn to HubSpot.
The automatic transfer reported here is from Apollo to HubSpot.
The unchanged MeetAlfred lead count concerns whether HubSpot contacts transfer through the Zap, not whether a campaign and Zap mapping can be created.
The new campaign showing zero leads is a lead-transfer failure after the campaign and Zap were created.
This message describes the Zap's lead-transfer trigger and its failure to process contacts that predate the Zap.
The successful transfer of a newly added test contact verifies the lead-transfer trigger rather than campaign creation.
This message requests web forwarding and belongs to the separate campaign-domain forwarding Requirement.
